collects.description: The rollback of now, which the collection after the switch drops.

rollback.description:
The release that becomes the rollback; `null` when the update changes no layer or the target
serves nothing.

Answer.description: What the follower says about the planner release of a release.

reason.description: Why the follower does not serve it; `null` when it does.

bytes.description: The bytes of the verified files.

got.description: The day of the last `archive get`.

listed.description: The files that the last get listed.

listed_bytes.description: Their bytes, as far as the manifest knows them.

root.description: The root that has its manifest.

verified.description: The files of the manifest that are in the root with their size: they serve.

free_bytes.description: `null` when the root does not exist.

ArchiveStatus.description: The output of `obc data archive status`.

unarchived.description: The sources with `keep = "archive"` that no dataset has.

boxes.description:
A box for each part: the box of a box region, and the bounds of each Geofabrik area in the
cached index.

missing.description: Why a part has no box; `null` when each part has one.

areas.description: Its areas whose path or name holds the query.

index.description: The version of the cached Geofabrik index; `null` while the store has none.

regions.description: The regions of `data/regions/` whose id or name holds the query.

step.description: The step that cannot be planned.

Cause.description:
Why a layer is stale: exactly one of three causes. When more than one applies, the first in
this order is the cause.

oneOf.description:
The version of the layer is not that of the release. `from` is `null` when the release has
no step of the layer.

A source has a newer version to use. `to` is the version that the steps read, or the newer
version upstream; `null` when upstream names none.

A layer or a source that the layer reads has other files, or `options`: the release has
other steps of the layer, or a step with other options, inputs, `params` or `client`.

Check.description: One thing that an action needs.

action.description:
The arguments after `obc data` of the command that applies the fix, which the page runs
after a confirm; `null` when a person applies it.

blocks.description: Whether the action waits for it.

commands.description: The commands of the fix, one per line.

fix.description: What to do about the problem, and where the commands run.

problem.description: Why it fails; `null` when it passes.

CleanPlan.description: What `clean` removes from the store, or removed.

store.description: The snapshot records and the objects that nothing reaches, and what stays.

Code.description: The kind of an error. It sets the exit status and the fix.

oneOf.description:
An argument is not valid, an id names nothing, the command runs outside the repository, or
another command must run first.
A command that asks has no terminal to ask in, and no `--yes`.
The person did not answer yes.
A file under `data/` is not valid.
A fetch or an upstream check failed.

A credential is missing: a fetch failed without the credential of its source, or the R2
variables are not set. Or a layer cannot be planned, the target cannot take the command, or
this machine cannot do the work.
R2 or rclone failed, or refused a key.

A release failed its check before a target serves it, or after an upload the object in the
bucket is not the file.
A run failed: the build, or the run that `runs RUN --follow` shows.
The store or the file system failed.

keys.description:

collection deletes at most.

copy.description: The files that the home lacks.

held.description: The files that the home holds.

root.description: The archive root of the home of the source.

versions.description: Each version of the target, oldest first.

hint.description: What to copy there, in one line.

register.description: Where a person gets the credential.

file.description: The file that holds the values now.

names.description: The names of the values that it wrote.

overridden.description:
The names that the environment of the command sets, from the shell or `tools/obc.local`:

there.

sources.description: The sources that the credential serves; none for a credential of `deploy`.

fields.description: The values that the command reads, one per line, in this order.

set.description:
The arguments after `obc data` of the command that sets it from standard input, such as
`source credential SOURCE` for each source that needs it. `null` for the R2 key, which the
page does not set.

uses.description: The `use` of each source that it serves.

oneOf.description: Each listed file is verified.
A listed file is missing.
No root has the manifest.
The manifest cannot be read, or has no `version`: no file of it serves.

args.description: The arguments after `obc data` that start it.

commands.description: The commands that it runs in the repository root, in this order.

commit.description: The commit of this checkout that it deploys.

checkout.description: The commit of this checkout: what a deploy puts in place.

publish.description: What `update prod` and the delete of its old data need on this machine.

Detached.description: What a command that starts a detached run writes: the run.

Error.description: Why a command failed, and what to do about it.

client_bytes.description: The size of the files that a client reads: what a target gets.

guess.description:
It comes from a build of the step with other options, such as another region, scaled to the
input size of the step.

Failure.description: What `--json` writes when a command fails.

at_once.description:
The most block programs of the `terrain` prepare that read the source at the same time, 4
when it is not set: a service that answers slower under many requests holds fewer slots.

oneOf.description: A person orders or downloads the files.
A person installs it, or another source's build brings it.
`obc data source prepare` makes its versions in the archive.

Fetched.description: The requested files of a snapshot.

archive.description: The path in the archive (`OBC_DATA_ARCHIVE`) of the file that gave the bytes instead of `url`.

name.description:
The part of `url` that names the file within its source, unique in a record: the name a
step gives the file when it needs one.

oneOf.description: The number that the readers check.
The number of the output.

ForRegion.description: What a bake of the region reads of a source, and what it still needs.

after_stop.description:
The step list of a product that reads it stopped before it read the source: its fetches
are not known, and `need` is `unknown` but for a prepared source.

held_bytes.description: The known bytes of the held ones.

held_requests.description: Of them, those that the store or the archive holds.

read_by.description: For a source that only a prepare reads: the prepared source whose need it has.

requests.description: The fetches of the source that the step lists read: one per set of params.

unknown_requests.description: The fetches to download of unknown size.

readers.description: What the new format means for each reader of the layer.

GcPlan.description: What `clean` deletes from the store, or deleted, and what stays.

keep_bytes.description: The size of the objects and the unpacked copies that stay.

objects.description: SHA-256 and size of each object that nothing reaches.

partial_bytes.description:
The size of `partial/`: unfinished downloads and the work of steps that stopped. A
collection removes it.

snapshots.description: `source@version` of each snapshot record that nothing reaches.

unpacked.description: The SHA-256 and size of each unpacked copy of an archive file that the archive no longer lists.

Held.description: How this machine holds a source.

archive_files.description: The verified and the listed files of its dataset; `null` while no manifest lists a file.

bytes.description: The bytes held; `null` when the source holds none of its own.

covers.description: Where the source has data, in words.

dataset.description: The dataset of `data/archive/` of the source.

date.description:
`YYYY-MM-DD`: the last `archive get`, the newest version that holds it, or the newest file
in the store.

download_bytes.description: What an `archive get` still takes; `null` when unknown or nothing is to get.

error.description: Why its dataset or its prepared versions cannot be read.

gap.description: A national terrain model that nothing holds: the terrain there is GLO-30 only.

no_dataset.description: `keep = "archive"`, and no dataset of `data/archive/` has the source.

prepared_by.description: The prepared source whose versions hold it: itself, or the one that reads it.

store_requests.description: The requests of the source with params in the store, the newest of each set of params.

store_versions.description: The versions of the source in the store.

where.description:
The archive root of its dataset, the home of the prepared source that holds it, `store`, or
the host of an asset that R2 keeps; `null` when nothing is held.

Holder.description:
The run that holds the lock of a target. A reader ignores keys that it does not know, so builds
of `obc data` read each other's lock.

heartbeat.description: The time of the last heartbeat, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

machine.description: `OBC_DATA_MACHINE`, or else the short host name.

progress.description:
Each layer that the run bakes, at the last heartbeat. The status of the run on its machine
has the detail.

review.description: The id of the review that the run does; `null` until the run has it.

waiting.description:
Why the run waits, in the phase `router-ready`: the last answer of the follower of the
target.

Keep.description: Where the copy of a source that a bake reads stays, so that no outage stops a bake.

oneOf.description: The archive (`OBC_DATA_ARCHIVE`) holds the whole dataset: a fetch reads it there first.
The store keeps what each fetch took.

We keep what we make: the archive keeps a prepared source and a source that only a prepare
reads, and R2 keeps our own asset.

Kept.description:
A snapshot record, the layers of one step, or the objects that one kind of root names and no
kept record or layer has.

because.description:
`served by TARGET, …`, `newest of the source`, `newest of a request`, `refreshed`, `inputs
kept`, `release`, `fixture`, `in the archive` or `archive not read`.

Kind.description: In the order `obc data sources` lists them.

oneOf.description: An input that steps read.
A file that ships to users as it is.
Code that steps run; nothing of it ships.

LayerChange.description: A layer that the update changes.

dropped_leaves.description: The grid leaves of `drops` of a tiled layer, as `leaves` names them.

drops.description: The steps of the serving release that no step makes now.

format.description:
The format of the serving release and of the steps, when it changes. Old readers keep what
they have and get no new data until they update.

leaves.description:
The grid leaves whose steps bake, as `<i>-<j>`: the last part of the name of each step of a
tiled layer that has that form.

partitions.description: The partitions of a partitioned layer whose steps bake.

readers.description: The programs that read the layer.

leaves_done.description: The leaves `<i>-<j>` of a tiled layer whose steps finished, and those whose steps bake now.

leaves_unchanged.description: The finished leaves whose steps all kept their output of the serving release.

started.description: When its first step started, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`; `null` before.

total.description: The steps of the layer that the run bakes, and those that finished.

LayerShape.description: How the steps of a layer bake.

oneOf.description: Per grid leaf.
Once over the coverage of a target, also in named partitions (`partitions`).

LayerSources.description:
A name of `used_by` and the sources that it reads. Whether a bake of a region still downloads
or prepares is in `sources --region`.

sources.description:
The `data` sources and assets whose `used_by` has the layer, but no source that only a
prepare reads.

cause.description: Why a `stale` layer is stale; `null` for another state.

format.description: The format and the revision of its steps; `null` for a layer that only the release has.

leaves.description: The grid leaves of a tiled layer, as `<i>-<j>`, sorted; empty for another layer.

partitions.description: The partitions of a partitioned layer that its steps make, sorted; absent for another layer.

readers.description: The programs that read its files.

reads.description:
The layers and the sources that its steps read, sorted. In place of a layer that no program
reads, it names what that layer reads.

served_format.description: The format and the revision of the layer in the release; `null` while the release has none.

shape.description: How its steps bake; `null` for a layer that only the release has.

stale_leaves.description: The leaves whose steps a build changes.

stale_partitions.description: The partitions whose steps a build changes.

text.description: The cause in a few words; `null` without a cause.

Legacy.description: The keys of the legacy pipelines that a target does not use.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the lines `<bytes>  <key>\n` of the keys of every folder, sorted by key.

folders.description: The keys of each folder, sorted.

how.description: The command, or what to do, with absolute paths.

links.description: How each app of this machine and of its network opens a dir target; empty for an R2 target.

network.description: Its origin on the network, for a phone; `null` without a network and for an R2 target.

url.description: The origin of `obc data serve` on this machine.

died.description:
Whether the run ran on this machine and its process ended: the next run takes the lock
over.

heartbeat.description: The time of the last heartbeat, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

machine.description: `OBC_DATA_MACHINE`, or else the short host name.

progress.description:
Each layer that the run bakes, at the last heartbeat. The status of the run on its machine
has the detail.

review.description: The id of the review that the run does; `null` until the run has it.

Whether the last heartbeat is as old as `unlock` needs, by the clock of this machine: the

waiting.description:
Why the run waits, in the phase `router-ready`: the last answer of the follower of the
target.

colour.description: The header colour of its page: `data/machines.toml`, or else the charcoal of a laptop.

memory_bytes.description: `null` where the system does not tell.

name.description: `OBC_DATA_MACHINE`, or else the short host name.

store_free_bytes.description: The free bytes of the disk of the store; `null` where the system does not tell.

memory_bytes.description: `null` where the system does not tell.

refusals.description: Why this machine cannot do the update; empty when it can, or cannot tell.

store_free_bytes.description: The free bytes of the disk of the store; `null` where the system does not tell.

text.description: What the layer bakes without and the command that gives it, or the version that it reads.

checked_at.description: None for policy-derived capture results and sources without a probe.

waiting.description: Why it waits: in `router-ready`, the last answer of the follower of the target.

again.description: Whether the step builds also when the store has the layer of its key.

key.description: `None` until the layers and snapshots that it reads are in the store.

recipe.description: The key of the step without the digests of its inputs.

oneOf.description: Missing, but no main job needs it.

held.description: How this machine holds the source.

boxes.description: Its boxes, and the bounds of its Geofabrik areas in the cached index.

countries.description: The countries that select the national models; empty selects each that meets a box.

download_bytes.description: The sum of the known bytes to download.

products.description: The products with each optional part on, and whether their step lists are complete.

sources.description: Each fetch that a baked step reads at another version than the serving release.

peak_rss_bytes.description: The highest estimated peak of one bake.

rollback.description: The release that it served before.

oneOf.description: `keep = "archive"`.

them.

bytes.description: `None` while it runs, and when it failed.

checks.description: What a deploy from this machine needs, each checked now.

commit.description: The commit that it runs; `null` when it does not answer, or when its build named none.

reason.description: Why it cannot serve a release of `obc data`; `null` when it answers.

definitions.description: The TOML text of the region and of the members of a union, by id.

definitions.description: Full TOML definitions of the region and its union members, keyed by region id.

layers.description: The parts that are on, sorted.

from.description: `null` when the serving release does not read the fetch.

bytes_built.description: The size of the layers that it built; a reused layer is not counted.

bytes_fetched.description: The size of the files of its fetches.

layers.description: Each layer whose steps it bakes, in the order of the plan.

phases.description: Each phase that it entered, in order.

pid.description:
The process of the run: while it starts, the process that reserved it, and then the
process that it starts.

switched.description: The releases that the run switched the target to.

free_bytes.description: `null` where the system does not tell.

used_bytes.description: The size of every file in the store.

Stored.description: A version of a source in the local store.

StoredRequest.description: A fetch of a source with params, as the local store records it.

fetched.description:
When its newest file was retrieved, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`; `null` for a fetch without
files.

Summary.description: A run, as `obc data runs` lists it.

args.description: The arguments after `obc data` that started the run.

area.description: The area of the serving release, as boxes that a map draws; `null` while it serves nothing.

at.description: The folder of a dir target, or the public URL of an R2 bucket.

blocked.description: The steps that cannot be planned.

drift.description: The pointer keys whose bytes are not those of the serving release.

error.description: Why the target or its steps could not be read; `null` when they could.

layers.description:
Each layer of the steps and of the serving release; `null` while the target serves nothing
or its steps cannot be listed.

lock.description: The run that holds the lock of the target; `null` while it is free.

lock_error.description: Why `lock.json` of the target cannot be read; `null` when it can.

made.description: The machine that made the serving release, and when; `null` while it serves nothing.

next.description:
The command to run next, or the run to wait for while it holds the lock; `null` when the
target serves its settings as the steps make them now. For an R2 target, the command is the
review: its update needs the id that the owner approved.

notes.description: What layers bake without, such as a prepared source that no target lists yet.

parts.description: The parts that the serving release has on, as `--add` names them.

region.description: The region of the serving release.

release.description: What `release.json` of the target says; `null` while it serves nothing.

serve.description:
Where `obc data serve` serves a dir target, and how each app opens it; `null` for an R2
target.

sources.description: Each source version that the serving release read.

detail.description:
The version that the tool gives, or the command that installs it; both when the version is
too old.

file.description: The file that holds the host key now.

guess.description: The bakes whose estimate is a guess from a build with other options.

peak.description: The bakes whose estimate has no peak.

size.description: The fetches whose size is not known, as `SOURCE@VERSION`.

holder.description: The run that held the lock.

source.description: The prepared source whose lock it freed; `null` for the lock of a target.

target.description: The target whose lock it freed; `null` for the lock of a prepared source.

uploaded.description: `false` when an immutable key already held these bytes.

oneOf.description: The service captures current data on demand; no network probe establishes a version.
The source has no cheap upstream probe.
The release has the layer as its steps make it now.
No step makes the layer: an optional layer that is off, or a layer that only the release has.
A build changes the layer.

Version.description: An entry of `versions.json`, which lists the complete versions oldest first.

format.description: The format of the manifest: a target reads only a version of the format of its producer.

region.description: The region of its scope; absent for a version of every place that the source covers.

VersionScheme.description: How upstream names a version, and so what a version of the source looks like.

oneOf.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`: the only scheme that gives a version an age.
The SHA-256 of the file.

View.description:
A run as `obc data runs RUN` gives it: its status, with the users and the earlier times of its
steps, and the end of its log.

args.description: The arguments after `obc data` that started the run.

bytes_built.description: The size of the layers that it built; a reused layer is not counted.

bytes_fetched.description: The size of the files of its fetches.

layers.description: Each layer whose steps it bakes, in the order of the plan.

log_path.description: The path of that log on the machine of the run.

phases.description: Each phase that it entered, in order.

pid.description:
The process of the run: while it starts, the process that reserved it, and then the
process that it starts.

review.description:
The review that a run of `update --plan` wrote, as `update --dry-run` writes it; `null`
for another run, and until the plan is done.

switched.description: The releases that the run switched the target to.
